name: dsh-plugin-grasp-probe
description: Verification-gap probe for DeepSeek Harness: a backend plugin that watches each user turn, judges steer/ride/neutral with a cheap LLM, and accumulates how far the AI's autonomous progress has outrun what the user has actually verified — surfacing a faint, ignorable prompt (over an in-memory Connection RPC channel, never the session log) when they've drifted out of grasp.
